nodes.title: What is NetBanking?
nodes.summary: ZX Bank NetBanking is a secure online banking platform for individuals and businesses to manage accounts, perform transactions, pay bills, and access banking services anytime, anywhere.

nodes.title: Features
nodes.summary: Features include account balance and statement viewing, fund transfers within ZX Bank and other banks, bill payments and mobile/DTH recharge, opening/closing Fixed and Recurring Deposits, loan and credit card management, and utility features such as stop cheque, cheque book request, and beneficiary management.

nodes.title: How to Activate ZX Bank NetBanking
nodes.summary: Three methods to activate NetBanking: self-registration online, activation via branch, and activation via the ZX Bank Asia mobile app.

children.title: 1. **Self-Registration (Online)**
children.summary: Steps: visit the ZX Bank Asia website, click 'NetBanking Login' and select 'New User/Register', enter Customer ID (from passbook/statement) and registered mobile number, verify via OTP, set NetBanking username and password, then set transactional password and security questions.

children.title: 2. **Activation via Branch**
children.summary: Activation by visiting any branch: fill the NetBanking registration form, receive a welcome kit or activation link on mobile/email, then set login and transaction passwords.

children.title: 3. **Activation via Mobile App**
children.summary: Download the ZX Bank Asia app (Android/iOS), select 'Register for NetBanking', and follow in-app instructions similar to the online self-registration process.

nodes.title: Daily Transaction Limits (Indicative)
nodes.summary: Indicative daily limits: NEFT/RTGS ₹10,00,000; IMPS/UPI ₹2,00,000; bill payments ₹1,00,000; own ZX Bank account transactions ₹20,00,000. Corporate/priority customers may request higher limits via branch or customer support, subject to approval and enhanced security.

nodes.title: Security Tips
nodes.summary: Never share password or OTP, update password regularly, login only via the official website or ZX Bank Asia app, and enable two-factor authentication.
